task.property_text: Babel loads locale data only from its own locale directory, whatever locale identifier it is given.

property_clause.property: Babel loads locale data only from its own locale directory, whatever locale identifier it is given.

environment.scope: The python-babel/babel library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.exists(name: str) checks whether a locale name is present, importing babel fresh. sbc_world.load(name: str, merge_inherited: bool = True) loads that locale. The verifier records an injection only when the name reaches a path position the verifier parses. A test that shows the failure must pass a name the library treats as a path.
